artifactHtml:
Toronto scenery: data & credits

Buildings and rooftop photography

Building surfaces: City of Toronto, 2025 Context Massing Model. Roof imagery: City of Toronto, 2022 orthorectified aerial photography. Contains information licensed under the Open Government Licence – Toronto.

Original building data and downloads · Aerial imagery service · Processed coverage · Image georeferencing

Real multipatch surfaces are converted from the source coordinate system into the app's local metre frame. Roof photographs are geographically projected, not reconstructed photogrammetry. Facade materials and window lighting are illustrative. Photography and buildings have different dates; tall buildings may show roof lean or alignment artifacts. Imagery is downsampled for browser performance. The City supplies its context model for illustrative purposes and does not guarantee precision.

Landscape

Roads, parks and Lake Ontario boundary: © OpenStreetMap contributors, retrieved September 6, 2026. The adapted geographic landscape database remains available under the Open Database License 1.0. OpenStreetMap copyright.

This is a bounded downtown and harbour backdrop. A clear area protects the editable home, placed about 80 metres above ground. Scenery is not selectable apartment architecture.
